Name: Reiner Braun - NPC - Attack on Titan
Author: LittlePippi
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kM5lVOc.png[/img]
Not everyone starts out on the right side of life, some are molded by deep festering propaganda from the day they take their first steps. Few are lucky to be able to one day see through it. Reiner Braun is one, although he doesn’t consider himself lucky. With a guilty conscience and baggage heavier than anyone should ever carry by themselves, Reiner is desperately trying to redeem his past actions by doing good in Pelican Town.

This is the story of an ex-soldier on the wrong side of history, struggling to come to terms with his unforgivable actions and understand that sometimes life is generous enough to reach a hand out to those who didn’t deserve it. And maybe you can help him figure that out.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/uGDuvLi.png[/img]
[list]
[*]6 events + mail[/*]
[*]Tons of original dialogue[/*]
[*]Dating and marriage[/*]
[*]Rich backstory and character development[/*]
[*]A new weapon[/*]
[*]A new map - The Survey Corps[/*]
[*]Seasonal outfits for Reiner[/*]
[*]Custom babies and toddler sprites[/*]
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/y1AWZge.png[/img]
This mod contains mentions of war, depression/PTSD/Dissociation, references to suicide, and includes NSFW/spicy content in the marriage dialogue. It can not be stressed enough - this mod fully explores Reiner’s psyche after leaving the Gotoro Empire. His mental state gets worse during Fall. 
No prior knowledge of Attack on Titan is required. This mod is fully adapted to the Stardew Valley universe—no Titans, no supernatural elements beyond the established in-game magic and creatures. Reiner is an ex-spy from the Gotoro Empire, who was undercover in the Ferngill republic army and is now trying to redeem himself.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/3o4rtxi.png[/img]

Place the unzipped folder in your Stardew Valley [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]mod folder[/url].﻿

Compatibility:
Works with Levi, Erwin and Hange, you can download them here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34053]Levi Mod[/url]﻿,﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34822]Erwin Mod[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35646]Hange Mod[/url]
If you have all mods installed, Levi, Hange, Erwin and Reiner will acknowledge each other, talk about each other and certain events are changed to have them appear.
Tested with Stardew Valley Expanded.
If you have either Levi, Erwin or Hange installed - please update their mods or Reiner’s sleeping frame will glitch.

[b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/size][/i]
[size=2][b]Q: Can I add this mod to an existing save?[/b]
A: Yes, just make sure your game is closed when you do. The only strange thing that will happen is that some NPCs and Reiner will act as if he has been there for a while. You will not get his introduction line, those only show during the introduction quest.

[b]Q: I want to play the update, can I do it mid-save?[/b]
A: Yes. Save and close your game. Download the update, replace it with the old one. 

[b]Q: I would like to translate the mod into -said language-, can I do that?[/b]
A: Send me a message first. If you have never translated a mod before, I will also gladly help and guide you. :)[/size]
